name: solderbench
description: An open-source synthetic benchmark for PCB solder-joint defect inspection algorithm development. It provides a configurable NumPy-based point-cloud simulator of five solder-joint classes (good, insufficient solder, excessive solder, bridging, collapse), a seven-feature geometric descriptor extractor, six baseline classifiers, and reproducible comparison and ablation experiment runners.
